caption: A basketball thrown from the free-throw line hits the front of the rim, bounces up, and falls to the floor.

sa.check: A basketball is thrown from the free-throw line.
It hits the front of the rim.
It strikes the front of the rim rather than passing through the hoop.
The throw comes first, then the rim, then the bounce, then the fall.

pc.expect: The bounce starts where the ball meets the rim and the ball leaves that point upward or outward, slower than it arrived.
pc.fail: The ball changes course before it reaches the rim; or it leaves the rim quicker than it arrived; or it carries on past the rim's line unchanged.

pc.expect: After the bounce the ball rises, slows, and comes down to the floor.
pc.fail: The ball hangs above the rim after the bounce; or it keeps rising out of the frame; or it sinks from the rim at one unchanging slow drift.

pc.expect: The ball stays outside the metal of the rim and outside the backboard.
pc.fail: The ball passes through the ring of the rim; or it passes through the backboard; or it sinks into the rim and comes out the other side.

pc.expect: The ball squashes briefly at the rim and on the floor and springs back round, and the rim stays rigid.
pc.fail: The ball stays flattened after a bounce; or the rim bends and stays bent where the ball strikes it; or the ball sticks to the rim.

pc.expect: One ball and one hoop are there throughout.
pc.fail: The ball vanishes at the rim or a second one appears; or the ball turns into another object at the bounce; or the rim disappears from the backboard.

pc.expect: The ball's colour and seams, the backboard markings and the court stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour at the bounce; or the square painted on the backboard shifts between frames; or the court behind rearranges.
